selection_explanation: Every connected bright region is retained in per-date candidates.csv. Artifact rules and ranking produce the review-candidate tables. first_pass_review_plan.py then selects a manageable 106-row validation and review batch; 106 is not the number of detections and not a confirmed-lightning count.

training_policy.current_action: Store human labels without changing detector parameters.
training_policy.future_action: A project owner manually starts a versioned training experiment after label quality review.
